attempted_claim: Fix p=3. Let M04=P^1\{0,1,infinity}, M05={(t1,t2) in M04xM04:t1!=t2} with forgetful map pr:(t1,t2)|->t1, Pi04, Pi05 their geometric pro-3 groups, and Q05 the metabelianization of Pi05 with explicit finite presentation (Bellingeri-Godelle-Guaschi generators, Chen-rank abelianization) reduced mod 9, pushed out to 1->Q05->E05->G_{Q,S}->1 with S={2,3}. Let s4 be the fixed tangential section at 0. Decide the metabelian pentagon-lifting criterion: is it true that s4 lifts to a section s5:G_{Q,S}->E05 with pr_*(s5)=s4 satisfying the pro-3 pentagon equation modulo commutators-squared if and only if the diagonal cup product b cup a in H^2(G_{Q,S},Z/9(2)) computed on the (b,a) S-unit ledger vanishes? A complete answer is either a proof of this equivalence with explicit braid-matrix ledger, or an explicit lifted s5 with pentagon solution and nonvanishing diagonal cup, or a proof that the diagonal cup vanishes while no pentagon-compatible lift exists.
decisive_failure: The finite-level cup nonvanishing and tame-symbol triviality lemmas are machine-verified, but they decide neither direction of the target iff; the metabelian pentagon obstruction and its identification with the diagonal cup were not established, so no equivalence, lift, or obstruction proof is claimed.
